body: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked tokens with bidirectional attention. Extending reasoning across generation chunks normally requires keeping earlier generated text in context. We ask whether a dLLM can instead continue reasoning after that text is cleared, using only a fixed-size carried state. We implement this state as a small number of register tokens: dedicated fixed-position tokens whose continuous hidden states are trained to carry reasoning progress across generation chunks. We post-train dLLMs to decode a chunk of text, clear it while preserving the register values, and continue decoding from the prompt and carried state. In our main comparisons on LLaDA and Dream, registers outperform discrete-text carry on every benchmark, with gains of up to 8.5 points on math and 19.5 points on code. Registers are especially effective for bounded code generation, where correct programs usually span several chunks. Finally, registers can be further refined with reinforcement learning on long-horizon reasoning tasks.
summaryZh: 本文针对掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）在长序列生成中难以保持推理状态的问题，提出了一种基于寄存器标记（Register Tokens）的解决方案。通过在模型中引入固定位置的寄存器标记，模型能够将推理进度以连续隐状态的形式跨分块传递，从而在清除旧文本后继续进行逻辑推理。实验表明，该方法在数学和代码生成任务中表现优异，相比传统离散文本传递方式，在代码生成任务中准确率提升显著，为扩散模型处理长程推理任务提供了新思路。
